name: Logitech G mice (fixed-feature)
description: Lighting of the older wired Logitech G mice OpenRGB drives with fixed HID++ feature indices: G203 Prodigy, G Pro and G Pro HERO (one zone), G303 Daedalus Apex and G403 HERO (two zones, in software control with saving to flash off, as OpenRGB does), the G203 LIGHTSYNC (three LEDs, per-key frames) and the G600 (feature report 0xF1). Adapted from OpenRGB's LogitechGLightsyncController, LogitechG203LController and LogitechG600Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. No hardware effect, DPI, report rate or onboard-profile command is ever sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/logitech-mouse.md.
